Our Mission

At Pilot Sales Distribution, we believe in empowering businesses with access to high-quality products at wholesale prices. We're committed to building a marketplace built on trust, transparency, and efficiency — making wholesale purchasing as simple as retail.

We connect buyers with verified suppliers, streamline logistics, and provide exceptional customer service to ensure every transaction is seamless and successful.

Our Values

The principles that guide everything we do

Trust & Transparency

Verified suppliers, authentic products, and clear pricing with no hidden fees.

Speed & Efficiency

Quick ordering, fast shipping, and streamlined logistics for bulk purchases.

Partnership

We grow with our customers and suppliers, building lasting business relationships.

Global Reach

Serving businesses worldwide with international shipping and multi-currency support.

Our Journey

2020 — Pilot Sales Distribution founded with a vision to simplify wholesale purchasing.
2021 — Onboarded first wave of verified suppliers and catalog offerings.
2022 — Expanded globally with suppliers across multiple regions.
2023 — Grew verified catalog and supplier network with Trade Assurance.
2024 — Launched RFQ system and real-time chat with suppliers.
2025 — Strengthened Trade Assurance, verification and buyer protection.
2026 — Continues to grow with verified wholesale inventory, Trade Assurance and per-offer confirmation.
